| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=9086d4d1a1eb43458610e00291a657c8&_e=uQ2qkY9i_kQwcAL0XNFpDmhsEV-aBP7TSRKrx63WjtWw0A9tlFNTyBZ3gHHheYgl2J0bwCtz8X7tca0jrE8XIF8vfnd1SCOwZEzuO8lefChB1Zvla_KejlhpNil16Hob6YdjBw9wSMS2R66bIa_VNGGedzEj04gsimsr7tLdts5wobqqpls9w3zo9IkZv24QmLIk_tWr4t1VvTIAQmSxRw1fpto0WJn19pgazZ9cFT5usoUdYsWeEiisPsc5RfYludcqFFbx4iiUORJUU4v1po8-DAiM3us2VNd1qxTZRPaf0kkOnxLGHaod9LiZ2044N0khmMO6gOlHx9Dka0pRNRt5FAq4hj1Jfk6M-FZbzXiR0mFgbqA6RFtU81AVqF3i4lk_ASphGWi31rGswO05NQ%3D%3D "Johnson1")**_

* Grocery stores were stocked with fairly-priced food.
* Interest rates were low.

* Gas topped off at around $10 per gallon in some places.

Our Governor said in a recent interview that he is "not sure what more we could do" to protect women and people with reproductive organs’ rights. Good enough is just not enough right now. We have to do better. You deserve to know what can be done to protect you. Well, I laid out a comprehensive plan of "what more we could do." As Governor I will: 1\. Take necessary steps to make Vermont a safe haven for all who are here and all who come here to seek abortion for any reason. 2\. A Shield law which will protect care providers from investigation and medical license penalties for charges from other states. 3\. Change Vermont's extradition laws in order to protect doctors, anyone who supports someone accessing abortion or those who come here to exercise reproductive liberty, marriage equality or gender affirming care. 4\. Increase funding for reproductive health and support funds to ensure that those who come here to access abortion will not end up with this service on their insurance bill. In addition to taking other data privacy measures. 5\. Change Vermont's fair and impartial policing policy to bar Vermont law enforcement and any state agencies from cooperating with out of state investigations into reproductive health care and gender affirming care. 6\. Codify access to contraception through an equal rights amendment to our Vermont constitution as well as LGBTQIA rights and marriage equality as well. 7\. Plan and prepare for intrastate refugees to Vermont. 8\. Build a coalition with neighboring states to look at and implement a plan to protect Vermonters and our fellow Americans in the event of a federal ban that is being planned by Republicans across the country. We must work with neighboring states to develop a robust proactive plan. 9\. Pass mandatory paid family and medical leave and other supports in order to put in place a robust system to support those who do carry a pregnancy to term. 10\. Finally, codify all forms of reproductive liberty into law so that there is no question that it is solely the choice of the person as to whether or not they have children. We need action. We need a leader who is prepared for this moment. We are not in a wait & see moment, yet we have a wait and see Governor. We must be prepared for what is to come and what is here now. clean_body: | | Friend, Weeks ago I outlined my comprehensive plan on reproductive & civil liberties. Our Governor said in a recent interview that he is "not sure what more we could do" to protect women and people with reproductive organs’ rights. Good enough is just not enough right now. We have to do better. You deserve to know what can be done to protect you. You deserve leadership that thinks ahead. **** Well, I laid out a comprehensive plan of "what more we could do." As Governor I will: 1\. Take necessary steps to make Vermont a safe haven for all who are here and all who come here to seek abortion for any reason. 2\. A Shield law which will protect care providers from investigation and medical license penalties for charges from other states. 3\. Change Vermont's extradition laws in order to protect doctors, anyone who supports someone accessing abortion or those who come here to exercise reproductive liberty, marriage equality or gender affirming care. 4\. Increase funding for reproductive health and support funds to ensure that those who come here to access abortion will not end up with this service on their insurance bill. In addition to taking other data privacy measures. 5\. Change Vermont's fair and impartial policing policy to bar Vermont law enforcement and any state agencies from cooperating with out of state investigations into reproductive health care and gender affirming care. 6\. Codify access to contraception through an equal rights amendment to our Vermont constitution as well as LGBTQIA rights and marriage equality as well. 7\. Plan and prepare for intrastate refugees to Vermont. 8\. Build a coalition with neighboring states to look at and implement a plan to protect Vermonters and our fellow Americans in the event of a federal ban that is being planned by Republicans across the country. We must work with neighboring states to develop a robust proactive plan. 9\. Pass mandatory paid family and medical leave and other supports in order to put in place a robust system to support those who do carry a pregnancy to term. 10\. Finally, codify all forms of reproductive liberty into law so that there is no question that it is solely the choice of the person as to whether or not they have children. We need action. We need a leader who is prepared for this moment. We are not in a wait & see moment, yet we have a wait and see Governor. We must be prepared for what is to come and what is here now. My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=71231c8b518c44599dcaa230cf4f0999&_e=EHWKnTZWxet-jpzCY40o546SMKvn4q_dzT5k6h618k30YD1N814fOZF0Dx9Is-uji6F69bQd2NkI8CD_ehrq0gLmAZxXwT8nPg2P2iysNxC_wKwa43Q1AJTZn0jYrXLUFX0h-SG7n2Pjqk6H_jeOijxKf_tybrZ8NPay5-FaX7HWnEz8yydE5iFxRsjeTcA6ctUUIdjnWi4ACuo6KAlOqG14zEqjcU-h55KWGa-ZTnWvoMMHlEcZLV9ypaVvqFl60OXdmrREgfBJXSemrKf1hIiOTvcdOj4ppJ-3mbQEX7cpKUAkXCqMWaUqfxY1mzPMDUcbH_ZM9n0ridK929cB6MN-uAKTstLjE2ganh_6n0FMcMdP6YcfB4wWYme0FdSq "Johnson1")**_

Ron

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer will bring the bill to the floor in the coming weeks, and our voices need to be heard now.
**Fundamental rights are being threatened. A Senate filibuster is all that stands in the way of federal protections for same sex marriage.**

My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---

---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=34b2048057a04ecebe29695a191fb8a2&_e=ndF0uNFmUmi0wJJpmYrP_3g0Fp1Anmfbmj1sQG393rrc3_2mR-zr9L9Ui_Hnpwo_tu2nLm9qJC0UhtUrR7MPzGQom20Jr_JCZQFfzqUZk-bqkixJgCrWo9yrPvvnnmtwfaqEu7E_MRHN-656K6OqpQNY_BREYV19soxaTdl6IUgD3LW1qqoSIu-KCI1rhp7-V0eQq73Xzw3p4ozBViDxEh6ciQhW3iuLoJiCGvl0_mvMEftRYpL0wui8HFAxFeKN2_Sl4O99TpaHdYceY6NA7goY_F8zXaUri-poKqEA93j67S--8BhX-Rp1s73fYj4u-CzhpdeNAiQI8i0D4cPzOx644zjO3AaTwOwibzF9xwTzDBgSFSJy8Y9yt8zzHyD8C7vcu7jmaeqgFSfRvyokKA%3D%3D "Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington? ")**_

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

body:
Some members of the GOP have started to oppose our democracy itself.
|
---

**“In fiery midterm speech, Biden says GOP’s turned toward 'semi-fascism'”**
— _The Washington Post_ **President Biden isn’t holding back, team:** | “The MAGA Republicans don’t just threaten our personal rights and economic security. They’re a threat to our very democracy. They refuse to accept the will of the people. They embrace — embrace — political violence. They don’t believe in democracy.”
“This is why in this moment, those of you who love this country — Democrats, independents, mainstream Republicans — we must be stronger.”
---
With some of our most fundamental freedoms on the line, President Biden is right: Those of us who are fighting to preserve our democracy _must_ be stronger than those who are working to destroy it.
**The NDRC is working to help elect pro-democracy candidates in 17 target states across the country this November, but we need your help to keep up all our work. Will you pitch in now to support our efforts?**

* 11:30 AM - 12:00 PM - Meet & Greet
* 12:00 PM - 2:30 PM - Picnic Lunch and Yard Games

Tilden Woods Local Park, 6800 Tilden Ln, Rockville, MD 20852, USAAbout The EventCelebrate the Constitution and Citizenship Day at the Tilden Woods Local Park. Meet Gregory Coll, Christopher Palombi, and others from the Montgomery County GOP, Potomac Women's Republican Club and more. name: Kari Lake
subject: WATCH: Can you believe Biden said this about you?
body:
| | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)
---
| | Peter, do you think the 74 million+ people who believe in the America First agenda are threats to democracy? **_The Biden administration does. _** They said so recently when the president referred to us as "semi-fascists," and his press secretary backed up the statement. **[WATCH THIS INSANE VIDEO FOR PROOF >> ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)**
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)
---
My opponent hasn't condemned these outrageous comments, either. _That's because she's part of the same political ruling class as Joe Biden._ These elitists think they KNOW BETTER. They think they ARE BETTER. And they do not think YOU matter. If you're like me, you're sick and tired of these dismissive "leaders" who continue to fail us. _**[It's time for the NEW RIGHT to fight back.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)**_
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)
---
[**I AGREE: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)
---
There's no doubt in my mind that the Left is going to come after me with everything they've got. They're going to sit in their basements and lie, and cheat, and hope they can convince Arizona to vote for a socialist like my opponent. But that's not going to work. **Arizona knows me.** They watched me on Fox 10 Phoenix for years as a journalist. We became friends as I stood by the truth, and now they know I will work hard to protect this state. That's why I'm in this. I'm not in it for the money. I'm not in it for any fame. I've already had that. It's overrated. I'm in it because I love Arizona and can't wait to get to work.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Peter, let's not forget that the race for Governor of Arizona is one of the most important fights in the entire country.** ** It's our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. ** ** It's our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay.** ** And it's our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track.** ** Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona!** ** Now, all eyes are on us. ** ** It's game time.** ** And I need you on my side.** ****_[Will you support our momentum?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)___**
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)_** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266948:6VI44KVNL:m:1:3317145305:83EDBFF6BFB9DE04E7921279BBABECC6:r)
---

Anthony

body:
| | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266879:JhPajdVN4:m:1:3331421248:ED416818C9A894706F0F1DC665837984:r)

| | Peter, From kindergarten to college, our education system has been absolutely radicalized. _For 12 years, we send our kids daily to be indoctrinated by extremists. _ They tell them they are oppressed, that America is racist, and there are like 13 different genders. Then, when that 12 years in school are up, we send them to college to do it EVEN MORE! Most of our students come out of college with a distorted, depressing worldview. And even worse, they've also paid A LOT for that indoctrination. _[**FIGHT BACK >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266879:JhPajdVN4:m:1:3331421248:ED416818C9A894706F0F1DC665837984:r)_ Now, Joe Biden and the Democrats are trying to bribe America's young people with student loan "forgiveness" plans. **Here's the thing, though: the problem is NOT the payments. It's the whole damn system.** If Joe Biden wanted to "fix" the cost of education, he'd do what we did here in Arizona. **We STOPPED funding THE SYSTEM and started funding THE STUDENTS. **That made our education system accountable to parents, taxpayers, and students instead of the progressive administrators who had every incentive to drive the cost UP and the education DOWN.
_Turns out, we have some excellent ideas on the state level_. But Joe Biden doesn't have any of those. He's FULL of bad ideas. Our states can no longer afford to live under the moronic rules of this administration. We cannot afford to pay the record-high bills he's racking up. _Whether it's expensive student loan plans or countless billions sent over to Ukraine with ZERO accountability, it's TOO much. _
It's time to stand up to this out-of-touch, out-of-control regime and SAVE AMERICA _.___[**Are you with me?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266879:JhPajdVN4:m:1:3331421248:ED416818C9A894706F0F1DC665837984:r)__

I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I'm the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**

---
Together, we're going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me... there's a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I 've always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that's not going to stop now!_

There's no doubt in my mind that the Left is going to come after me with everything they've got. They're going to sit in their basements and lie, and cheat, and hope they can convince Arizona to vote for a socialist like my opponent. But that's not going to work. **Arizona knows me.** They watched me on Fox 10 Phoenix for years as a journalist. We became friends as I stood by the truth, and now they know I will work hard to protect this state. That's why I'm in this. I'm not in it for the money. I'm not in it for any fame. I've already had that. It's overrated. I'm in it because I love Arizona and can't wait to get to work.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266879:JhPajdVN4:m:1:3331421248:ED416818C9A894706F0F1DC665837984:r)

**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. **_➡️ SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **_➡️ HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **_➡️ SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **_➡️ SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**__[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266879:JhPajdVN4:m:1:3331421248:ED416818C9A894706F0F1DC665837984:r)__
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **[_We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266879:JhPajdVN4:m:1:3331421248:ED416818C9A894706F0F1DC665837984:r)[.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61266879:JhPajdVN4:m:1:3331421248:ED416818C9A894706F0F1DC665837984:r) ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**

Both of these governments are creating a manufactured crisis, Friend.

These are the effects that politicians are ignoring.

body:
I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zicpi3h8bu8hpngrevmf7ugmob7qnensdf8btr4g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u5r3atr4suqb9p34s9ie0sb3mjh6cs3lemq6bcj2eer72d5mehq6epdgsip73dpnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjjcoq61ddm6upb2pjgm2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or3cpg66pj2cji649fg)
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlvvifsu6l8n8kkgp7h1jbdf7ihguuff6orrht3g_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcgl2ujnhansslt7nnqghngfacki79q57cg4knno_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkhd92silempq2l6001lfcsi6jmbh9t9eae419no_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment – they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8liua5fie8rhjikaugdnu9i1050lgine18gvio8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv2rid82r6jfnbig28f6j6mh47tbnsk320g4pbbg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND of $35, $50, $100 or more to stop this attempt to crush him?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbb8btlvoblr9c02r1t80gtognvj3ebsakemmgh0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs)** [**DONATE**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk28qqfevraqh59psq73gf513imc4s2hjujtfdpg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs) [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z42mfhtb1rginu6s9cqh0eh8ojn7v11d6rh4eb10_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. [Please consider supporting our efforts with a generous, tax-deductible donation.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfi90clg8nou9dd31e1kj881vj6a983oi8hci14o_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs) © Thomas More Society | [www.thomasmoresociety.org](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfhhumd6lvmqtjc6oqmpdqkmot2c2u0h1sv1pbjo_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj4shh2bs)

---
Friend, After hijacking teachers’ unions, shutting down schools, injecting (woke) race and gender politics into classrooms, and labeling all who disagree as “domestic terrorists,” Democrats have successfully driven _thousands_ of parents to pull their kids from public schools. Many of these parents are working extra hours to pay private school tuition or making incredible sacrifices to homeschool their kids while juggling all the other demands of life. **Now that a new school year is starting, we can’t let the liberal media sweep these issues under the rug.**
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zntf39bcj6id5cp34psk2dch13jd8ppdh5ql77ro_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj6c3h2bs)
---
My name is Jason Miyares. As Virginia’s Attorney General and a father of three young girls, I’m deeply worried about what’s happened to our schools under Democratic rule. **_Under Democratic Rule, Public Schools are Teaching Children to:_**
* REJECT history and the values that made America great.
* EMBRACE radical gender ideologies that contradict biology.
* ACCEPT political correctness –– without searching for actual **truth**.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message ➡️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "Washingtonians
need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268461:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268462:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "All
Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268462:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268462:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "JOIN TEAM
SMILEY")
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268463:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268464:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268464:JXHXsdVfN:m:1:3331421248:A45EF93C8E308575D44CF3D154971AD3:r "Step up now!")**_

---
---

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z7jkja0knepontp2lgeoe79bbhs16m6djmq0phjg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1hmcoj2cth2bs)

Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friends —
When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system to help me through.
Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.
Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.
Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.
Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.
In combat, I had my wingmen.
With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.
And in these campaigns, I have you.

body:
I’m reaching out to give you an update on one of the most competitive Senate races this year.
| | |
---
Team, Senator Cory Booker here. I’m reaching out to give you an update on one of the most competitive Senate races this year.
**The New Hampshire primary is TODAY, and with Mitch McConnell and the GOP already spending over $53 MILLION on ads to defeat Maggie –****and with more ads likely on the way after polls close tonight – I can't help but be nervous.**
Listen, I’m not exaggerating: What happens in New Hampshire could determine the future of our Senate majority.

subject: Eric Schmitt's votes can be bought – just name your price

Peter, I don’t need to tell you that Washington is badly broken. We see it every day.
It’s full of too many career politicians who are there for their own gain and would rather hobnob with lobbyists at fancy restaurants and enjoy luxury trips sponsored by corporate interest groups than put the needs of constituents first.
**While politicians in Washington are living it up, families back home are paying the price.** There’s a reason Congress won’t cap insulin copays at $35 a month for working families, crack down on price-gouging corporations to protect Missourians who are just trying to fill up their tanks with gas, or take real action to invest in affordable housing to help working families get by. And it’s got a lot to do with the nearly **$4 billion** that was spent lobbying Congress last year alone.
**We all know that Washington is broken – and we've all had enough.**
**That's why I am releasing[a government ethics plan](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50629391/366611192/-1161685747?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&redirect=http%3A%2F%2Ftrudybuschvalentine.com%2FEthics&code=jtk275-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTE0MmE0MS03MTMzLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Idk1PDSjNeZmBgOu04meINkW9URJFc78wgPhVBfYkPk=&emci=adfb5210-1b2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=69142a41-7133-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063) to clean up Washington and make sure that our leaders report to the families they serve – no one else. Here's my plan:**
* I’ll work hard to pass laws that **prevent members of Congress from becoming lobbyists** after they leave office, to **stop corporate PACs** from buying our elections, and to **ban foreign corporations and governments from hiring lobbyists** to sway lawmakers’ votes.

* I'll **publish my calendar publicly** so Missourians can see exactly who I’m meeting with – and who I’m not meeting with.

* I’ll work to **ban members of Congress and their spouses from trading stocks** and ban congressional family members from being paid by lobbying firms.

* And I'll work to make sure that **special interest groups can't pay for lawmakers to go on fancy trips** that are often little more than luxury vacations.

I'm really excited about this plan, but overcoming the powerful, deep-pocketed forces against these reforms won't be easy – and I won't be able to do it alone. **That's why I've launched a grassroots petition to show Washington insiders the powerful, broad support for change.[We've set a goal to reach 10,000 signatures before midnight tonight, so please: Will you add your name now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50629393/366611194/-1161685747?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&redirect=http%3A%2F%2Ftrudybuschvalentine.com%2FEthics&code=jtk275-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTE0MmE0MS03MTMzLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Idk1PDSjNeZmBgOu04meINkW9URJFc78wgPhVBfYkPk=&emci=adfb5210-1b2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=69142a41-7133-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**
| | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50629395/366611196/-1161685747?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&redirect=http%3A%2F%2Ftrudybuschvalentine.com%2FEthics&code=jtk275-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTE0MmE0MS03MTMzLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Idk1PDSjNeZmBgOu04meINkW9URJFc78wgPhVBfYkPk=&emci=adfb5210-1b2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=69142a41-7133-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)

I’m running against Eric Schmitt, a career politician who, if elected, will fit right into Washington's broken system. He has already gleefully accepted more than $10,000 in gifts from lobbyists – everything from golf trips to sports tickets to Christmas hams.
**Eric Schmitt has made it clear: His vote can be bought, just name your price.** That's not how our government should work and it's time we change that.
**When I get to Washington, I’ll put Missourians first every time. I'll be nobody’s senator but yours. _And by passing this plan, we’ll make sure the rest of Congress can say the same._**
Big change like this doesn't happen overnight. It takes powerful, united grassroots movements to win the real reform families need. **[So please, will you add your name in support of my plan to help me build the public pressure campaign that it'll take to pass this legislation? I need another 2,583 signatures before 11:59 p.m. tonight to hit my goal, so I'm really counting on your name to get across the finish line.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50629397/366611198/-1161685747?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&redirect=http%3A%2F%2Ftrudybuschvalentine.com%2FEthics&code=jtk275-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTE0MmE0MS03MTMzLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Idk1PDSjNeZmBgOu04meINkW9URJFc78wgPhVBfYkPk=&emci=adfb5210-1b2e-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=69142a41-7133-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**

Peter, Hispanic Heritage Month begins in just two days, and I wanted to take a moment to honor the 3.9 million Hispanics who call New York their home.

Our Hispanic neighbors are our first responders, our teachers, our service workers, our business owners, and so much more. New York is enriched by its vibrant Hispanic communities, and for that, I want to celebrate the critical role that they have played in New York’s economy, politics, and culture for generations.

**But despite all the opportunities that New York has to offer, the truth is that the odds are _still_ stacked against members of the Hispanic community.****** Only **_16.4%_** of Hispanics over the age of 25 have a bachelor's degree (compared to 35.8% of white, non-Hispanic people), and **_1 in 5_** Hispanic households hold educational debt.

This debt has, in turn, severely limited their ability to save for retirement or emergencies. A 2016 study found that only _**15%**_ of Hispanic families have three months of living expenses saved, and _**83%**_ of Hispanic millennials have no retirement savings at all. This puts Hispanic families in an extremely vulnerable position, making them just one accident away from ruin.

**Peter,****generations of predatory lending, pernicious landlord practices, manipulative financial schemes, and pervasive systemic racism have severely harmed our Hispanic communities****– and that’s why I’m doing everything I can to finally clear away these barriers.** As your attorney general, I’ve fought to hold bad actors accountable, protect the rights of U.S. citizens in Puerto Rico, shut down predatory debt collection, and so much more.

But my work isn’t over until every last New Yorker has access to the same opportunities. That’s why I’m running for re-election now, and I hope you’ll join this fight with me.

**So I have to ask:** [**Will you make a contribution to my campaign for re-election now so I can continue to tear down the barriers that the Hispanic community has faced for generations? name: Chrissy Houlahan
subject: 2018 was just the beginning
body:
Just like our first race, this one is also an uphill battle
| | |
---
**Derek, 2018 was just the beginning. **
Ever since you elected me as the first woman ever to represent Pennsylvania's 6th Congressional District, I’ve been fighting to deliver on our bold vision for the future: protecting reproductive freedom, great jobs, affordable health care for all, equal opportunity for everyone to thrive, and more! I don't plan to slow down either and here's why:
After my father came to the United States as a refugee fleeing war-torn Poland, he was given the opportunity to attend Columbia College and later had the honor to serve in the Navy. Following in my father's footsteps, I went to Stanford and MIT and served in the Air Force. I knew then what I know now: I wanted to give back to my community and the country that has given me and my whole family so much.

As an entrepreneur, after starting and leading several companies, this spirit of service led me to become the founding COO of B-Labs, so I could help small businesses grow in a sustainable, community-enriching manner. Soon thereafter, I worked as a chemistry teacher in North Philadelphia as a Teach for America Corps member.
Then, after President Trump was elected in 2016, I saw how nervous my family was about the future of our country. From my daughters to my father, we were horrified about what was to come. That's when I decided to run for Congress, to make life better for our Commonwealth, and for you.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50631726/366621182/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk688-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjdiOTY3MS03NTMzLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nwJgLemb9D5RASy0z78fL4s7VV9kbb6gVQOJJ3NtaAo=)
My experiences have helped shape my political vision, and I've never stopped fighting for PA-06. But my opponent and his allies are doing everything they can to block our mission of progress – and now House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy has made our district a top target in this year's midterm elections.
Just like our first race, this one is also an uphill battle. But we proved that if we stand together, we can make a better future for everyone in PA-06. In many ways, our work has only just begun. [**Please, Derek, can you donate $5 so we can power our movement to victory and keep this seat and the House blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50631727/366621183/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk688-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjdiOTY3MS03NTMzLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nwJgLemb9D5RASy0z78fL4s7VV9kbb6gVQOJJ3NtaAo=)
Thank you for your support. There's work to be done.

Chrissy

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures 👉
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268260:6FiGYdVqN:m:1:3334294963:78B969D5EC297E20765395306807E086:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268260:6FiGYdVqN:m:1:3334294963:78B969D5EC297E20765395306807E086:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268260:6FiGYdVqN:m:1:3334294963:78B969D5EC297E20765395306807E086:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268260:6FiGYdVqN:m:1:3334294963:78B969D5EC297E20765395306807E086:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268260:6FiGYdVqN:m:1:3334294963:78B969D5EC297E20765395306807E086:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268260:6FiGYdVqN:m:1:3334294963:78B969D5EC297E20765395306807E086:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61268260:6FiGYdVqN:m:1:3334294963:78B969D5EC297E20765395306807E086:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

| Hi ,
We are in a drought - there’s no debating that.

Daily you’re being told how conserving water is essential right now.

But did you know - just 4 years ago **we had 3 months of the wettest years on record in California?**

This is important: If we change our policy on water conservation, we wouldn’t be in ‘crisis’ mode over water ever again.

I explain it right here.
---
| [ ](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=14af56f430&e=f9133ea432)
---
| [Go here to watch.](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=bfb6295282&e=f9133ea432)

Here are the facts.
* We haven’t created a new reservoir since 1965, despite a growing population
* We have billions set aside for a new reservoir project, yet Gavin Newsom won’t use it.
* Our biggest reservoir in the state is not our dams. It’s our Sierra mountains.

Come this November, we’re steering this ship in a new direction.

I believe in a Californian future that isn’t constantly in a state of crisis.

Thank you for joining me!

\- Senator Brian Dahle

It’s expensive, and I’m currently finalizing our budget for the last month of this critical toss-up race. subject: How concerned are you about rising gas prices in America?
body:

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zdctrchond7ct8rf80fbasdb6njv8ue9bkqiq8so_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1geap30clh2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zq43jetr8lrgdp7rahn34oovevs2s7n2va0eqbp0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1geap30clh2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe
VP, Development

I grew up in Iowa. There’s not a lot to do there, but that’s where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. Dear Friends & Neighbors, As many of you know, my campaign for Congress is well underway. With less than 60 days to go before election day, when I’m working at my business or meeting new friends at Monterey County Fair this past week, I find it inspiring and it gives me hope to meet others who are also looking forward to a change in leadership in Washington. But there’s no getting around the fact that times are tough right now. I’m hearing it from my neighbors at the grocery store. I’m feeling it every time I put gas in my car. You get the sense that everyone is tightening their belts at home in order to balance their budget, everyone except those who keep passing these problematic policies that aren’t based in the real world. **I think you’ll agree that it’s time for a change in Congress.** Even a small investment in my campaign today will go a long way and I need your help to take our message back to Washington. Can you help today by sending [$5, $10, even a $25 donation](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/404196?id=11631.112.1.53afa35931039fff3a9ad3a6622ee6a7)? Every dollar will go a long way to making sure we can reach every voter in the 19th Congressional District so they know what I stand for: ▪ Restoring Energy Independence
▪ Strengthening Our Borders
▪ Protecting Our Pocketbooks
| ▪ | Restoring Energy Independence
---|---
▪ | Strengthening Our Borders
---|---
▪ | Protecting Our Pocketbooks
---|---
The election is less than two months away, so I need all hands on deck for donations, endorsements, volunteering and putting up yard signs. We can do this, I know we can. If you haven’t already, please stop by the [campaign website](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/404196?id=11631.113.1.14dde5b0ddc66460d4a42599f7891986) to learn more.
Together, we can make a change.
Yours,
Jeff

Peter,

This is the most disgusting thing I've seen on Twitter.

Middle schools in Tampa _(where we have a chapter and an educational youth programming site)_ have books in their libraries with **explicit** gay sexual content.

This book, Juno Dawson's _This Book is Gay_ , gives instructions to young boys on anal and oral sex, hand jobs, and how to use Grinder, the gay hook-up app. There is a section called "Boy-on-Boy Sex," which includes cartoon sketches of _a naked adult man in a book for 11- to 13-year-olds_.

Our educational youth programming teaches children about academics _without access to progressive ideologies like this_! It is part of our effort to fight against woke policies in schools.

Thankfully, one school board member, Lynn Gray, is on our side after part of this book was read at a meeting.

Gray stated that:

_**" Much damage has been done in terms of trauma to the audience -- both young and old after listening to the verbal descriptions."**_

But one school board member isn't enough to solve this problem.

I need your help to give parents an alternative to the woke sexuality schools are forcing on our children.

[_**Your urgent gift of $25, $35, $50, or more helps our long-term strategy of positively influencing the next generation >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61273893:6hN6odV2N:m:1:3317145305:CE62B74D22563DD8EC7C6CC003342FBF:r)

BLEXIT is teaching students about real American history, the values that make our country so successful, and the wisdom of our Founding Fathers.

Young people want to be independent, take responsibility, and escape poverty. BLEXIT is giving them a chance.

If you feel that way, you're no different from Leon Lett, who celebrated on the 2-yard line only to have the ball swiped away before he reached the end zone. There is too much, WAY TOO MUCH, at stake in this Senate race for us to let up one bit. Because I promise you, Raphael Warnock and his millions of dollars in campaign cash haven't let up yet. Now is the time to strike even harder to ensure that Herschel wins on election day. In 2020, New Journey PAC put tremendous resources into Georgia, and we need to double our efforts for the remainder of this election if we're going to turn out the Black voters who will vote for a Republican candidate for the first time in their life and deliver a victory for Herschel. **[That's only going to happen if you chip in $25, $50, or $1000 today to help us bring Black voters to the GOP so they cast their votes for Herschel and other Republican candidates this November.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61274185:JC3UVdVNw:m:1:3317145305:043ADCCF76A2F9FFD4B8CB9983EDE864:r "That’s only going to happen if you chip in $25, $50, or
$1000 today to help us bring Black voters to the GOP so they cast their votes for Herschel and other Republican candidates this November.")** Listen, Schumer's lapdog Raphael Warnock has already been cleaning up on the fundraising... $85 million at the latest count. Even, the media credited the record Black turnout for Warnock's win last year. But I refuse to cede the Black vote to the Democrats. Why you ask? Because I know we can win them over and bring them to the GOP. We've done it before and can do it again! At New Journey PAC, we know how to get Black voters to break the chains of their Democrat masters by showing them the GOP is the true party of freedom and prosperity and we believe this message is ripe for this year's election. **Herschel Walker is an American Dream Story. While his opponent believes America is a "Bad Country Full of Racist people," Herschel believes we are "a great country!"** **[Can I count on you to join our Georgia outreach to the Black voters in the Peach State? We need you to donate $50, $100, or $250 today to help Herschel win.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61274185:JC3UVdVNw:m:1:3317145305:043ADCCF76A2F9FFD4B8CB9983EDE864:r "Can I count on you to join our Georgia outreach to the Black voters in the Peach State? We need you to donate $50, $100, or $250 today to help
Herschel win.")** While we've got the winning strategy that will cement Herschel's victory, we just don't have enough money to fully implement our plan. [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61274185:JC3UVdVNw:m:1:3317145305:043ADCCF76A2F9FFD4B8CB9983EDE864:r "Headline")It's the same proven plan that got Burgess Owens and Byron Donalds elected to Congress and Winsome Sears elected as the first Black Lieutenant Governor in Virginia! Herschel is right when he says that Raphael, Biden, and the Left use race to divide us. But the only way we're going to get Black voters to hear that message and unite with Republicans of all shades and colors is if you step up today. **[That's why we need you to dig deep on this one. With all the money pouring into Georgia from the Leftist activists across the country, a $5 or $10 donation isn't going to cut it.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61274185:JC3UVdVNw:m:1:3317145305:043ADCCF76A2F9FFD4B8CB9983EDE864:r "That’s why we need you to dig deep on this one. make that happen with your donation today.")** For a New Journey, [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61274185:JC3UVdVNw:m:1:3317145305:043ADCCF76A2F9FFD4B8CB9983EDE864:r "James Golden, AKA Bo Snerdley")

The election this November is extremely important for Tennesseans for a number of reasons, but one of the top issues for many in this state is the extreme abortion ban that became law upon Roe v. Wade being overturned.
Let’s talk about the facts: under this law, there are no exceptions for rape or incest. A woman’s health is no exception under almost any circumstance. Together, we're going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me...there's a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I 've always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that's not going to stop now!_

I grew up in Iowa. There's not a lot to do there, but that's where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress" -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61274242:6zJxGdViN:m:1:3331421248:7F7A8BA1D1D8883E121E00F0F33B16E3:r)

**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. ➡️ **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **➡️ _HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **➡️ _SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **➡️ _SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61274242:6zJxGdViN:m:1:3331421248:7F7A8BA1D1D8883E121E00F0F33B16E3:r)_
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61274242:6zJxGdViN:m:1:3331421248:7F7A8BA1D1D8883E121E00F0F33B16E3:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**

With Election Day closing in, voters in our community are about to start seeing a ton of political ads. I’m sure you’re all super excited about that 🙄.

There's no doubt Ken Calvert and his super PACs allies are planning the standard barrage of mudslinging and distortions. So today, I wanted to share more about my story because I’d rather you hear it straight from me.

**[Before I jump in, our TV and digital ads are at risk of being drowned out by my opponent's. **I was 17 when the World Trade Center collapsed, and like many Americans, I felt a deep sense of patriotism and a duty to serve our country.** At that time, homophobic policies like “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” discouraged me from joining the military, so I decided to study law.

**After law school, I came home to California and clerked for two federal judges.** Then, as an Assistant U.S. Attorney, I helped prosecute white-collar criminals who defrauded seniors, thieves who targeted disabled victims, and corrupt doctors who perpetrated the opioid crisis. I also handled cases in counterintelligence -- including shutting down a smuggling operation that sent American-made microchips to China.

**In recent years, I’ve learned firsthand that some of the biggest threats we face are right here at home.** The January 6 attack on our capitol didn't happen by accident, and as a federal prosecutor working on related cases, I saw how extremists in Washington and media outlets helped contribute to the violence and division that’s eroding our democracy.

**My opponent Ken Calvert has been one of Donald Trump's most outspoken supporters.** He perpetuated the Big Lie that the 2020 election was stolen, and within hours of the attack, Calvert voted to decertify the election results.

**My campaign is about stopping extremism so we can get to work for the American people.** We need to agree on basic facts. Only then can we move forward on the things that matter -- improving health care access, growing the economy, and saving our environment from the climate crisis.

**[I’m committed to getting our democracy working again. That starts by ousting extremists like Ken Calvert who fuel and benefit from the chaos. Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s 48 hours until our final mid-month fundraising deadline of the quarter, and right now we’re still short of our $500,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**

If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. Hello, My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day. My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close. Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks. The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you. There’s 48 hours until our final mid-month fundraising deadline of the quarter, and right now we’re still short of our $500,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win.
