I wanted to share these special moments with you.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zj0m6jq81805gdvbt8k60mu84kpma9uoti1dihe0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ei3bd9ieir38cth6kpjactmekpradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf2c5jmaqnepj5c1j75d1nc9r3cdbm6uojactl66pr4tb5miqr6clm65r60ohmm3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj5cr0c1rm4phkcipmcdtgmlin48d245p25oh4cdhmco34s9g68pj24no)

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0nhi3fkja957schhnuf7ois8vi4socp60niagug_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zcl8ji81rgdu8g14aossq6nvvk6t5uvavp2cnkr8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpo73i3ivlr9lh3hijfe13lv6kb7rsi8pcrcciv0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv3q2ub870s0b9k7jjker3jr8vkf3jpsvcotsur0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5onq6c2tdhjub63ts761tidci5ugnenuvv7j2tg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zg6jjgpfr5nmk35d5arm2jom6gmv4qrskoamvdso_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjqhqgb131i6vivgsljk9669fr3coiok2g07rf9g_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zthhe3f4dj09061abhq3n57p1hagrvskkp7u5gco_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5601u33rtm558jsd6tsvp1ds6ir2m15tju30srg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztb1crp31gbvh5npqeh9hrti78bdshfc6p3gkc50_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9bfojj5l932iv18m6jv96kt8uf0s73posltn0po_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvk7tghj3f2640ri3vcgbg1gap5ule9tadqank18_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4le1g489hu47ocfq5t26iav30sv0nume7rskmoo_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrc662mupgug28mdb0259l4ji0s7f57snnbsdsv0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrtsrc08lhrc9em2h01j5gok996201uhft9hctg0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0290iugpedl31rckkmlua5acs3vu8fg2loj5tb8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgovfg5g79qe2ch4fi12rdu0djmlv15hr67b5fpg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zd2bca39j83rivptvt4ch5jilruhm9e9g3gbpa48_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie4o34cph2bs "Step up now!")**_

body:
The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it!
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z1366sfnjidckkt6tiu7ff3ltjstsagi7gkklrp8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie8p75cph238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij79hnmer7acjjegon9crl6crn2ct66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uir36d76m8qn9pjkmgq66dhleqor9ppl6dqeadtkslpmeptlmgoncdjncppj7dtnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6apm0o3nc5j35d5lmorr1db5e8iv0)

---
Fellow Patriot, [**I urge you, right this second, to sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States to save America**.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z09un0l291hpeh8nn0an1jit7sd0as6uuaod54no_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie8p75cph2bs) An army of conservative heroes including **_Mark Levin, Ben Shapiro, Sean Hannity,_** and** _Lt. Col. Allen West_** have joined our movement to call for an Article V Convention of States. [**Just click here to add your name to this national petition. And then PLEASE forward this email to every single person you know.**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z3ashuhh4m83oo3k1bjtqf781rm4lh1va8b5qpdg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie8p75cph2bs)
---
[**Sign The Petition**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zvt2ihtnr51jqhbb2a6bi3o2mjieke0sig6gn588_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie8p75cph2bs)
---
Our nation is spiraling out of control. Debt threatens to cripple our economy. Federal spending has never been higher -- nor has our deficit. And the politicians in Washington won't do anything to save us. _In fact, most of them are part of the problem!_ A Convention of States is our only hope. You see, our Founding Fathers were brilliant men. They left an emergency clause in the Constitution in case the federal government got too big and out-of-control. **Article V of the Constitution allows the states to bypass Congress and the President to call a Convention of States to propose amendments to our Constitution that will rein in the federal government.** Well, conservative leaders all across the country -- along with over **_FIVE MILLION_** grassroots patriots -- believe it is time to invoke Article V and call a Convention of States for the express, _limited_ purpose of imposing fiscal restraints and term limits on Congress and limiting the power, scope, and jurisdiction of the federal government. And I hope you do, too. With the socialists in control in Washington, it's time to take action before it's too late! It's time for "We the People" to use the most powerful weapon in our arsenal - the Constitution - to fight back against Washington's overreach. [**Please sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States right now, and please ask everyone you know to do the same.**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zkmro0rbojsk1c4cfca6iu4uvohcuj10m24tv1gg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie8p75cph2bs) Here at Convention of States Action, we are working overtime to convince the required 34 state legislatures to call for an Article V convention to place limits on the power and jurisdiction of the federal government. **We have already passed the COS Resolution through the state legislatures in 19 states, including four since the start of this year alone -- bringing us over __HALFWAY__ to calling a Convention of States and taking the power back from the "ruling class" in Washington!** This year alone, the Resolution has passed out of committee in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Iowa, and Kansas -- paving the way for the next round of states to pass! With dozens of states currently considering the COS Resolution, _NOW_ is our window of opportunity to double down and secure the needed victories to cross the finish line! We have a citizen activist army operating in all 50 states, working tirelessly to urge their state legislators to act in accordance with the will of the people and demand that they pass this critically important Resolution. **A Convention of States is our only chance to pass important and long overdue measures like a balanced budget amendment, term limits on Congress and the D.C. Swamp, and limits on the scope and jurisdiction of the federal government.** The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it! But in order for that to happen, we need millions and millions of patriotic Americans like you to sign this important national petition. We need to show the members of the state legislatures that the American people are ready for a constitutional solution as big as our nation's problems, an Article V Convention of States. [**Simply click here to sign and we 'll deliver it directly to your state legislators, free of charge. This is our best chance to save America from an out-of-control federal government.**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zuojavbgn6jcdg9d4a1gavg9opjo0l2i0fhcaj1o_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie8p75cph2bs) Washington won't fix itself. The federal government is too big, and the politicians are too invested in its growth. We the people must take control through our state legislatures. [**Please join the fight to call a Convention of States. Sign the petition today, and urge every freedom-loving American to do the same.**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zfke0emp08d3ei9c5dsaqammtdh77379b91m30fo_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie8p75cph2bs)
---
[**Sign The Petition**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zu74juahhaslogia1gp7tsco390t1ee035bvsri8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c1ie8p75cph2bs)
---
Thank you, and may God bless America! For America, Mark Meckler President Convention of States Action

body:
New Hampshire Republican State Committee

| Derek -- | | | | | |
# TODAY is the highly anticipated Primary Election! **Don't forget to go out and _VOTE_ TODAY in the Republican Primary! **
**Unsure of your polling place?[CLICK HERE](https://www.nh.gop/r?u=1ezA6orZLED7PQGtxnspG1kZYO_kzTlGNDpOW0YyF9-4q8AWAwsmC-fk27tNu_dSH7e0o8EMEjF--s3Iu-CGxhGeXue96CH1VyDjQHJ2hG6MLjHgY0FfvzC66eXZxIovjN4Silg54RMvfrFKDpNtIA&e=3b759f8f09083dafc3b676ab7322a136&utm_source=nhgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_day_blast&n=1)! ** There are numerous Victory Parties happening tonight. No RSVP necessary. **Kevin Smith -** Executive Court Banquet Facility (Manchester, NH) at 7pm. No RSVP necessary. **Gail Huff Brown -** 261 Central Road (Rye, NH) at 7pm No RSVP necessary. **Russell Prescott -** 50 Little River Road (Kingston, NH) at 7:30pm RSVP: [Click here](https://www.nh.gop/r?u=1ezA6orZLED7PQGtxnspG1kZYO_kzTlGNDpOW0YyF9-4q8AWAwsmC-fk27tNu_dSH7e0o8EMEjF--s3Iu-CGxsY5lp7orBX5902-P0tTsO0_6WK3XPD5RJsXTzTHDwOlkbjQbR2fn9DjE6DMTzb-0A&e=3b759f8f09083dafc3b676ab7322a136&utm_source=nhgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_day_blast&n=6) **_CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT 2:_** **George Hansel -** Tempesta's Restaurant (Keene, NH) at 6pm RSVP: [Click here](mailto:brendan@georgehansel.com)
**Lily Tang Williams -** 252 Pine Hill Road (Weare, NH) after 7pm RSVP: Text - [(603) 660-9521](tel:\(603\)%20660-9521) **Bob Burns -** Margaritas (Nashua, NH) at 7pm No RSVP necessary.

name: Eric Sorensen
subject: Running to represent all my constituents, not just the Democrats.
body:
Peter, for over 20 years, I delivered the weather and climate change information to the people of Northwest Illinois.
As a meteorologist, you never know exactly who you're talking to, but I was always aware that I was speaking to people of all political persuasions -- and the feedback I received reflected that. Liberals, conservatives, and independents all shared how they appreciated my energy, accuracy (let me tell you, if I was wrong, I heard about it!), and scientific way of talking about climate change. I had a similar experience on the campaign trail that I wanted to share with you.
I was in Kewanee, IL (a town about 45 minutes southeast of the Quad Cities) I found myself talking with a nice gentleman. He noticed that my clipboard said “Democrat” on it -- to which he responded “Oh no thanks, I’m a Republican”.
I asked what he did and he said he was a farmer. I responded, “Well I’m the meteorologist who thinks we need to be talking about climate change and I know you understand that, you deal with it every day!” He agreed and we talked about the need for action. Not “drop everything and totally upend the way our society works" action, but tangible, gradual steps towards a greener, more sustainable future. Just before he signed my petition he shook his head and said, “I can’t believe I found a Democrat who makes sense!”
Frankly, this is why I’m running for Congress here in IL-17. We deserve a representative who is trusted by the voters -- someone known by the community and has the ability to speak to folks of all political persuasions. Our current congresswoman Cheri Bustos showed us that, and I’ve been doing it here for two decades.
If you are ready to help us keep this seat Blue, THANK YOU! You can donate directly online here: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50629709/366612459/-295409223?refcode=em-9.13.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5M2EwMjFkYi03MTMzLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E5Ije1JNGrAgF6Tsym6qAgFvuULShQk7TgPnE1GlK-M=)
Wishing you the best and if you’d like to discuss my race further, please don’t hesitate to reach out at (309) 306-1717.

-Eric

Moline, IL 61265

body:
| | |

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: Gabriella Shanahangabriella@scottgryder.com
---
Oswego, Ill. – Lauren Underwood, Nancy Pelosi, and Joe Biden are driving our country and our state into the ground with their out-of-touch agenda. A new Gallup survey shows that _56% of Americans are struggling in the face of skyrocketing inflation_ and rising costs. IL-14 Rep. Lauren Underwood and President Biden have made our lives more expensive and more difficult. They put their radical, high-tax agenda ahead of the hardworking people of Illinois. Every piece of bad legislation that Lauren Underwood has voted for, Joe Biden has signed into law, and the government has benefited while leaving hardworking Illinoisans left to pick up the pieces of their failed policies. Scott Gryder said: “We’re seeing record-high gas prices because Nancy Pelosi and Lauren Underwood bowed to the demands of climate groups who are attempting to force Americans into buying electric vehicles that only the wealthy can afford. Taxes are going up because the Democrats rammed legislation through Congress that hikes taxes on working families. Purchasing household essentials has never been so expensive because of the Democrat’s reckless agenda." He added: “On November 8, we will change who controls Washington, D.C. and restore common-sense governance that puts people first. It shouldn’t be a contest for families to choose between buying gas or a gallon of milk, and for too many that has become the reality under the Underwood-Pelosi agenda.”
---
| | **More about Scott:** Scott has a long history of leadership for the community he serves. Elected three times to the Kendall County Board, Scott currently serves as its Chairman. By being a common-sense, pragmatic conservative, Scott has worked to keep taxes low and supported responsible spending policies on the County Board. He will take the same approach to Congress. Scott grew up in Plano and has called Kendall County home for most of his life. A graduate of the University of Illinois with a degree in business administration, Scott successfully pursued his law degree at DePaul. He is an active member of the Federalist Society and is licensed to practice law in Illinois and the U.S. Northern District of Illinois. Scott and his wife live in Oswego with their daughter. Outside of politics, he is active with the Oswegoland Park Foundation Board, is a PrairieFest Sponsor, and serves on the Fox Valley Family YMCA Board. ###

**[Lindsey Graham Proposes Nationwide Abortion Restrictions](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._sRFw7efARuVnOs8Y3AOQ)**
Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-S.C.) has introduced legislation that, if signed into law, would ban abortions nationwide after 15 weeks. on the table. Growing up outside Youngstown, he watched his family lose
their livelihoods as steel mills shut down and jobs got shipped overseas.
He learned the value of hard work from an early age and never forgot where
he came from.

That boy was me, folks. And now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to
make sure families like mine are taken care of and that all workers get
the dignity and respect they deserve.

I know what’s at stake in this election. We have a once-in-a-generation
opportunity to tilt the balance of power back to working families—and I’m
damn sure JD Vance and his dark money backers with their vacation homes
and private yachts won't get us there.

CNN ranks us as one of the most likely seats to flip in 2022—but to win
this race and make history, we need your help to overcome everything the

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90471/images/PDP%20Primary%20Logo.png]
Dear Peter,
Republicans are at it again.
First it was Republicans taking credit for the road and bridge repairs funded by President Biden’s Build Back Better infrastructure bill.
And now Republicans are trying to take credit for Democrats’ historic Inflation Reduction Act when – get this – not a single Republican voted for the bill.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90471/images/Donate-Inflation-Bill%20%281%29.gif]
That’s right. Every single Republican in Congress voted against cutting prescription drug costs for American families.
Every single Republican voted against lowering health insurance premiums and expanding healthcare coverage.
And every single Republican voted against strengthening the domestic manufacturers who employ 542,600 workers right here in Pennsylvania.
That’s pretty embarrassing.
Although they love to rewrite history, we won’t forget that while Democrats worked hard for months to get the Inflation Reduction Act across the finish line, Republicans obstructed them at every opportunity.
The IRA is the perfect example of why November matters so much. We need advocates like John Fetterman in Congress to fight for Pennsylvania families. We need a governor like Josh Shapiro who will protect abortion access, defend voting rights, and stand up for our Commonwealth.
Healthcare is on the line. Good paying jobs are on the line. Our planet is on the line.

body:
I’m Wes Moore, and I’m running for governor in the great state of Maryland | | Team,

I’m Wes Moore, and I’m running for governor in the great state of Maryland. I want to talk about my race and what’s at stake.

It’s undeniable that there’s a lot of political division in our country right now and a lot to be concerned about in this moment. But I know if we come together, regardless of party or background, we have a lot to be hopeful about.

While my opponent is focusing his time and energy on disparaging the nation’s top law enforcement agency and even threatening to use our state’s police and military against the President, _I’m focused on how to bring Marylanders together and lift each other up._

**We’re not just going out and asking Democrats to vote for us. We’re going out to every part of the state and asking all Marylanders to join our movement.**

When I led soldiers in combat in Afghanistan, one question I never once asked my soldiers was, “What’s your political party?” _It didn’t matter_. We had one job, one goal, one mission. And the same goes for this election.

We must unite as Marylanders to win not just this November’s election but this critical moment in our state and nation’s history.

In the military and throughout my career in public service, I have always led by bringing people together. **I will be a governor for all Marylanders, not one who seeks to divide and tear people apart.**

body:
All eyes will be on the Keystone State this November.
#
Derek,
We want to share something our team thinks about every day 👇
**This Senate seat is gonna be a real toss-up, so saving + expanding our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority could all come down to Pennsylvania.** All eyes will be on the Keystone State this November.
Don’t just take our word for it. **CNN has consistently rated PA as the #1 Most Likely to Flip state in the country.** (And we all remember what happened when Pennsylvania went the other way in 2016.)
**That’s why we’re launching a new goal to reach $250,000 in the next three days.**
**[Derek, if we’re going to defend + expand our Democratic Senate majority, we urgently need your help so John can beat Dr. Oz in November. Please, chip in what you can afford today to help us reach our $250,000 mid-month goal.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220913-1?refcode=em20220913-7231&refcode2=7231_434096_gT7UJD&akid=7231%2E434096%2EgT7UJD)**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220913-1?refcode=em20220913-7231&refcode2=7231_434096_gT7UJD&akid=7231%2E434096%2EgT7UJD)
Over the last year and a half, just a handful of Democratic Senators have single-handedly held up some of the most urgent legislation of this generation — **like dumping the filibuster + codifying _Roe v. Wade_ into law**.
Derek, when we send John to the Senate this November, not only are we nearly guaranteed to maintain our Democratic majority... but we will also add one more Democrat to our side.
This would make John the 51st Democratic YES vote on critical legislation, like passing vital voting rights legislation + saving Social Security.
**We can’t risk losing our Senate majority OR that 51st seat, Derek.** There is simply too much on the line.
That’s why we need all hands on deck to help carry our campaign’s historic momentum through November.
**[Can you please make a donation of $5 or more today to help us meet our $250,000 mid-month goal? Your support right now could tip the scales in this toss-up race + send John to the U.S. Senate this November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220913-1?refcode=em20220913-7231&refcode2=7231_434096_gT7UJD&akid=7231%2E434096%2EgT7UJD)**
**[Donate $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220913-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220913-7231&refcode2=7231_434096_gT7UJD&akid=7231%2E434096%2EgT7UJD)**
Thanks for your support, Derek. We wouldn’t be able to do this without online supporters like you.
—Team Fetterman 💛

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220913-7231-footer&t=1&refcode2=7231_434096_gT7UJD&akid=7231%2E434096%2EgT7UJD)**

subject: TONIGHT: Emergency Organizing Call – Celebrating Our Diversity; Defending Our Freedoms. Speaker Pelosi Grassroots Volunteer Update at 6PM PT / 9PM ET.

body:
Dear Friends,

Today should be a day of celebration for House Democrats as we join President Biden in promoting the inflation reduction law, welcome two new Members – Congressman-Elect Pat Ryan (NY-19) and Congresswoman-Elect Mary Peltola (AK-AL) — and prepare to kick off Hispanic Heritage Month. But Republicans have just announced a new assault on Americans’ rights and freedoms. Senate Republicans are moving full steam ahead TODAY to introduce a NATIONAL ban on abortion.

To be clear, their ban is what would be in store for ALL 50 STATES if Republicans took control of Congress in the upcoming elections. This is the nightmare scenario – they will NOT succeed. We are winning in November.

TONIGHT: Join me and my special guest Congresswoman Sylvia Garcia from Texas at a special later time for an Emergency Organizing Call to talk about the threats and our response at 6:00 pm PT / 9:00 pm ET. Register here:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_jZGR9gsCR_aB6hFz1s2yZw

As one of the first Latinas elected to represent Texas in Congress, Congresswoman Sylvia Garcia serves on the front lines of our Democracy: fighting to put people over politics and lower costs for families on the Financial Services Committee; and defending the rule of law on the Judiciary Committee, as the first Hispanic to ever serve as an impeachment manager in a presidential impeachment trial and as a trusted advocate for women.

Our Democratic Majorities in Congress are the firewall protecting our freedoms — and even with this latest challenge, we don’t agonize, we organize — and we unionize!

Thank you all for your support. You are our strength and our inspiration. See you tonight. And if you haven’t already, please follow me on Twitter at https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi [https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi] to get out the word – and get out the vote.

NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

Whether ready-to-use appliances, specialized distributions or your individual config, with custom images you can create cloud servers that are ideally prepared for their intended purpose from the very first start-up. Managing and using custom images has now become even easier, which means that you can build on the appropriate image in any situation.
\- Images as the base for new cloud servers - Managing custom images in the cloud control panel
Images as the base for new cloud servers
In order for new cloud servers to be available immediately, the operating system is not installed manually (e.g. from a DVD), but instead the root volume is prefilled with an image when a new cloud server is launched and this installation template is then further configured during the initial boot process.
You have been able to import and use your own images for a while now at. This enables you to create virtual servers in no time at all using a different operating system to those provided by us or using software and configurations that are completely adapted to your requirements. Where there are several available image files from distributors or third-party providers, it is often the case that one of them has been specifically optimized for OpenStack environments like at cloudscale.
Managing custom images in the cloud control panel
Managing custom images is now also possible in our web-based cloud control panel. Even if you are not using our API, the CLI or the DevOps tools we support, such as Terraform and Ansible, you can now import your own images at n order to start one or more virtual servers on this base. In addition, it is now possible to import images directly in QCOW2 format without needing to convert them to RAW first. It goes without saying that you also benefit from this simplified process if you continue to import images via API.
We recommend that you use `cloud-init` [1] for your own images, too. Using cloud-init, virtual servers can apply numerous settings automatically during the boot process, e.g. relating to the name and IP address of the server. You can also hand over many other options to cloud-init as "user data" at the time you create the server. In addition, you can specify for each custom image how our system should handle the user data. This is of particular significance if your image uses Ignition, which serves a similar purpose, rather than cloud-init. You will find further details about this in the documentation at [2].

[Les defis de securite fondamentaux que le Nigeria doit relever. Premier defi : identite](https://africacenter.org/fr/spotlight/les-defis-de-securite-fondamentaux-que-le-nigeria-doit-relever-premier-defi-identite/)
26 mars 2015
Le premier tour des elections presidentielles du Nigeria a retenu l'attention du monde entier. Pays voisins et parties prenantes internationales attendent avec impatience de voir comment le Nigeria va gerer le processus electoral tumultueux et qui dirigera le pays le plus peuple et la plus grande economie de l'Afrique dans les annees a venir. Le Nigeria est egalement au centre de l'attention en raison de l'augmentation des offensives de l'organisation extremiste violente Boko Haram. Les attaques de ce groupe ont en effet entraine la mort de plus de 10.000 personnes ainsi que des pertes territoriales dans d'État de Borno, dans le nord-est du pays. L'expansion des offensives de Boko Haram dans des pays voisins et les inquietudes concernant l'incapacite du gouvernement nigerian a endiguer cette menace ont precipite la formation d'une coalition internationale pour contenir ce groupe terroriste et le vaincre. Fait moins reconnu, Boko Haram n'est que l'un d'une serie de problemes de securite et de gouvernance interdependants que le prochain president du Nigeria devra confronter. Cette serie en plusieurs volets passe en revue certains de ces autres defis strategiques les plus pressants et etudie le leadership qui sera exige pour les resoudre.
PUBLICATION
[La lutte contre la piraterie dans le golfe de Guinee](https://africacenter.org/fr/publication/lutte-contre-piraterie-golfe-guinee/)
Par Adeniyi Adejimi Osinowo
28 fevrier 2015
Malgre le fait d'avoir gagne, au cours des dernieres annees, le titre de mauvais augure de « couloir de navigation avec le plus grand nombre d'actes de piraterie dans le monde », les reponses regionales a la piraterie et autres menaces de securite maritime dans le golfe de Guinee, ont ete fragmentaires. La connaissance du domaine maritime reste faible, la coordination inter-institutions est limitee et les mecanismes de coordination intra-regionaux qui ont ete etablis sont souvent sous-finances.
PUBLICATION
[Attenuer le radicalisme dans le nord du Nigeria](https://africacenter.org/fr/publication/attenuer-le-radicalisme-dans-le-nord-du-nigeria/)
Par Michael Olufemi Sodipo
19 aout 2013
Les attaques actuelles de Boko Haram et d'autres groupes Islamistes violents ainsi que les reponses parfois arbitraires des forces de securite nigerianes ont contribue a une deterioration de la situation securitaire dans le nord du Nigeria. Les attaques et les bombardements de plus en plus frequents masquent egalement des dynamiques de radicalisation plus anciennes. Il est necessaire de mettre en place une approche durable qui cible tous les stades du spectre de la radicalisation, du reglement des griefs socioeconomiques aux initiatives interculturelles de consolidation de la paix, ainsi qu'a la rehabilitation des membres radicalises des groupes islamistes violents, aussi bien qu'un usage plus mesure de la force afin d'inverser cette plus large tendance.
PUBLICATION
[Le militantisme islamique en Afrique](https://africacenter.org/fr/publication/le-militantisme-islamique-en-afrique/)
Par Terje Østebø
5 novembre 2012
La montee du militantisme islamique dans le Sahel, dans le nord-est du Nigeria et dans certaines parties de la Corne de l'Afrique a engendre un regain d'attention pour ces preoccupations securitaires changeantes. On aurait pu s'attendre a ce que l'interpretation Africaine de l'Islam, qui est historiquement tolerante et moderee, soit suffisante pour empecher les points de vue extremistes de gagner un support significatif, cependant ceci semble etre de moins en moins le cas. En regle generale, la connaissance de ce defi securitaire non-conventionnel est basee davantage sur des speculations que sur des evaluations empiriques. Les reponses doivent absolument eviter d'amalgamer des acteurs islamiques distincts tout en adressant les perceptions de desaffectation et de sous representation, au niveau local, qui encourage l'apport de soutien aux militants.
PUBLICATION
[Boko Haram : La menace evolue](https://africacenter.org/fr/publication/boko-haram-la-menace-evolue/)
Par J. Peter Pham
4 avril 2012
Une hausse dans les attaques a grande echelle, durant la derniere annee, par l'organisation terroriste islamiste du Nigeria Boko Haram represente une menace serieuse pour la stabilite de ce pays le plus peuple de l'Afrique de l'Ouest, par ailleurs le sixieme exportateur mondial de petrole. Le groupe a elargi avec succes sa presence geographique, a developpe de nouvelles tactiques sophistiquees, et a place en ligne de mire des symboles cibles de la presence internationale au Nigeria. Dans ce bulletin de securite de l'Afrique, J. Peter Pham evalue l'importance de cette recrudescence, examine les origines et les objectifs de ce groupe opaque, et met en avant des priorites pour contrer cette menace.
PUBLICATION
[Les moteurs pernicieux du conflit ethnico-religieux au Nigeria](https://africacenter.org/fr/publication/les-moteurs-pernicieux-du-conflit-ethnico-religieux-au-nigeria/)
Par Chris Kwaja
28 juin 2011
Le vieux conflit « indigene-colon » au Nigeria, dans la region de Jos, a augmente ces dernieres annees et pourrait se propager a d'autres regions ethniquement mixtes du pays--ce qui accroit l'instabilite. Naviguer au travers de telles lignes de fracture entre les communautes est un defi commun pour de nombreuses societes africaines; defi qui necessite l'etude des symptomes anterieurs afin de resoudre les causes systemiques. Au Nigeria, il s'agira de mesures pour attenuer directement la violence ainsi que pour realiser la reforme constitutionnelle.

We don’t need to guess how Senator Ron Johnson, Mandela Barnes’ opponent, will vote on this legislation, Peter. He’s already made it clear how he feels about abortion bans like this one: From Vanity Fair on June 30, 2022:
> _The two-term senator said he didn’t view the repeal of Roe v. Wade “as a huge threat to women’s health” and that things would be “fine.” He said anyone who does not like Wisconsin’s abortion laws “can move.”_

> _“It might be a little messy for some people, but abortion is not going away,” [Johnson] said, saying that driving across state lines to Illinois would likely be an option. “I just don’t think this is going to be the big political issue everybody thinks it is, because it’s not going to be that big a change.”_

> _“I also signed an amicus brief supporting Dobbs in overturning Roe, and also in protecting life after 15 weeks”_

clean_body: We must codify Roe v. Wade and protect abortion access once and for all. | | | Breaking news, Peter: Senator Lindsey Graham just introduced a 15-week abortion ban in the U.S. Senate. Although it’s unlikely that this ban will pass into law today, these attacks on abortion access are going to continue. There are two paths in front of us: Either Republicans take back the Senate and pass a national abortion ban, or Democrats codify Roe v. Wade into law once and for all. In order to do the latter, we need to gain two more votes in the U.S. Senate — and one of our best bets to do that is by electing Mandela Barnes. Lindsey Graham’s proposal would ban abortion in every state after 15 weeks — a timeline with no medical basis, according to experts.1 It would put the lives and health of pregnant people across the country at risk. We don’t need to guess how Senator Ron Johnson, Mandela Barnes’ opponent, will vote on this legislation, Peter. He’s already made it clear how he feels about abortion bans like this one: From Vanity Fair on June 30, 2022: The two-term senator said he didn’t view the repeal of Roe v. Wade “as a huge threat to women’s health” and that things would be “fine.” He said anyone who does not like Wisconsin’s abortion laws “can move.” From the Wall Street Journal on May 11, 2022: “It might be a little messy for some people, but abortion is not going away,” [Johnson] said, saying that driving across state lines to Illinois would likely be an option. “I just don’t think this is going to be the big political issue everybody thinks it is, because it’s not going to be that big a change.” And from an official statement from Johnson himself: “I also signed an amicus brief supporting Dobbs in overturning Roe, and also in protecting life after 15 weeks” Not only does Wisconsin deserve better, we as a nation deserve better than what Ron Johnson, Lindsey Graham, and other anti-choice politicians are giving us. We must send Mandela Barnes the U.S. Senate this November so he can shut down future national abortion bans and vote to codify Roe as soon as possible. There is too much at risk to not do all we can leading up to Election Day. In solidarity, Working Families Party 1\. , The 19th , June 8, 2022. Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Friend,
Mitch McConnell only needs to flip one seat to take back control of the Senate - and his Republican campaign arm has made me a target. I need to be very, very frank with you about what's at stake and why we must protect this seat with everything we have.
In a Republican-controlled Senate, a nationwide ban on abortion won't just be up for debate. It has been proposed and we will not be able to stop it from passing.

body:
Did you hear this?
#
Did you hear this?
When Greg Abbott was asked what he would say to a victim of rape or incest who wants an abortion but can’t get one under his extreme law, he responded that, **“They can get the Plan B pill.”**
Greg Abbott can get fired on November 8th. Let’s make sure he does.
[**Please, rush a donation now and join me in the fight to fire Greg Abbott and restore reproductive freedom in Texas. We can’t risk another term of Abbott’s cruelty and extremism.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220913-1.mBhlZi&refcode=ema20220913-207682&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=207682%2E444211%2Eabk2tz)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220913-1.mBhlZi&refcode=ema20220913-207682&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=207682%2E444211%2Eabk2tz)**
Greg Abbott doesn’t believe that the women of Texas deserve the right to make decisions about their own bodies, health care, or future.
It’s cruel and inhumane — and we need to reject Abbott’s extremism at the ballot box, and elect a governor who trusts women.
The good news is that all across the country, we’re seeing voters turn out in droves to reject the extreme anti-abortion candidates and ballot propositions that would take rights away from women.
The overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ was a wake-up call, and like my mom and former governor of Texas Ann Richards would say, I can hear America singing.
But we need to work together to ensure that when our moment comes in Texas — in just two short months — we’re ready to do the same. That’s why I’m urgently asking for your support today.
[**Please donate anything you can today to fire Greg Abbott and elect Beto. Texans deserve so much better than cruelty from their Governor.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220913-1.mBhlZi&refcode=ema20220913-207682&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=207682%2E444211%2Eabk2tz)
We aren’t going to let Greg Abbott get away with his attacks on the women of this state.
Keep fighting,
Cecile
Cecile Richards

clean_body: Did you hear this? Did you hear this? When Greg Abbott was asked what he would say to a victim of rape or incest who wants an abortion but can’t get one under his extreme law, he responded that, “They can get the Plan B pill.” Greg Abbott can get fired on November 8th. Let’s make sure he does. Greg Abbott doesn’t believe that the women of Texas deserve the right to make decisions about their own bodies, health care, or future. It’s cruel and inhumane — and we need to reject Abbott’s extremism at the ballot box, and elect a governor who trusts women. The good news is that all across the country, we’re seeing voters turn out in droves to reject the extreme anti-abortion candidates and ballot propositions that would take rights away from women. The overturning of Roe v. Wade was a wake-up call, and like my mom and former governor of Texas Ann Richards would say, I can hear America singing. But we need to work together to ensure that when our moment comes in Texas — in just two short months — we’re ready to do the same. That’s why I’m urgently asking for your support today. We aren’t going to let Greg Abbott get away with his attacks on the women of this state. Keep fighting, Cecile Cecile Richards National Finance Chair, Beto for Texas Former President of Planned Parenthood Email us: info@betofortexas.com

name: Laurie Teper
subject: Together Everyone Achieves More!
body:
TEAM Geels,
We are a TEAM, correct?
A team is **a group of people who do collective work and are mutually committed to a common team purpose and challenging goals related to that purpose**. ** _Collective work and mutual commitment are the key characteristics._**

**_
_**
Let 's come together as a _**team**_ to achieve a common goal. That common goal is to ** _#_**_**send the nurse to Congress!**_
_**
**_
_**Signups for Working the Polls Begin Now! Contact your County Coordinator ASAP**_
Many shifts are available!
Early Voting - October 20 - November 5
Election Day - November 8

We do have our challenging goals that lie ahead. I believe if _everyone_ who signed up to support Courtney Geels actually _commits_ to working one or more shifts at the polls, we can achieve our goal! We have _**162 precincts in District 4**_ to cover. We need every single person to help out. Will you commit to volunteering to hand out Courtney Geels palm cards in your precinct, in your county, in another county that has a higher priority?? Volunteer training is available from Courtney on several dates and times in October leading up to early voting. You have several options to choose from. Please contact your _County Coordinator_ (See below) for the date and time that works best for you and he/she will send you the link to hop on the call. It would be helpful if you RSVP'd to your county coordinator so we know who to expect. This should only take 20 minutes of your time. The following dates/times are when Courtney has set aside to assist you.

10/3- 9pm
10/4- 7am
10/5- 12noon
10/6- 7am
10/19- 7am
10/19- 9pm

_EVENTS THIS WEEKEND!_
_
_
_ORANGE COUNTY - Need volunteers!_
Friday-Saturday - Hog Day
River Park Downtown Hillsborough
144 E Margaret Lane
Hillsborough, NC 27278

###### Parking:
Look for free parking on the streets near River Park and the surrounding areas. If needed, a Parking Deck is located at Nash and Kollock Street (behind the Weaver Street Market). It may be even easier if a friend can drop you at the curb and pick you back up. Margaret Lane closes at 5:30 pm Friday night until the event ends on Saturday at 5 pm.

Door Knocking 9:00am-12:00pm
1720 Guess Rd, Durham - Northgate Parking Lot
Contact Renee at [rhill632@aol.com](mailto:rhill632@aol.com)

Our Community Heroes Concert FREE and open to the public! Noon-6pm
CIRCLE K RANCH, 2037 Yale Dr #9669, Graham

For more information: <https://www.keenonhorses.com/free-concert>

104 E Elm St, Graham

_
_

Creedmoor Music Festival 10:00am-5:00pm
Parking: Creedmoor Community Center - 108 E Wilton
For more information: <https://www.cityofcreedmoor.org/departments/recreation/events/creedmoor-music-festival>
Contact Noah at [noah@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:noah@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

_YARD SIGNS_
Courtney Geels Signs can officially be put out on public property beginning September 20!
Teams are forming to place signs September 20-25. Sign up to be a part of that team!
Contact your County Coordinator for details.

If you see a large sign out that needs mowing around, contact me! We have someone willing to do that.

I know that small businesses often face many struggles, and I am working to reduce the barriers to interacting with state government.

That is why as Secretary of State, I made it a priority to bring you the Kansas Business One Stop - a one-stop site to plan, start, and grow a business. This collaborative effort among state agencies serves entrepreneurs searching to file documents, find funding and resources, and other tools to guide them through the process of forming a business.

My administration is committed to expanding and enhancing the Business One Stop to provide more services online and continue making starting and growing a business in Kansas easier.

subject: Sign and send the petition: Demand Congress cap insulin prices.
body:
Cap insulin prices — save lives!
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **[Sign and send the petition: Demand Congress cap insulin prices.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2d07ecae-a720-4490-be32-729c06d1dada/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Congress passed the Inflation Reduction Act, which places a $35 cap on insulin for people 65 and over and on Medicare patients. **But millions of diabetics on private insurance will still have to pay substantially more for insulin – in many cases, more than they can easily afford. And uninsured people have it the worst--they are much more likely to pay the full list price for insulin than the privately insured and are much more likely to be unable to afford prescription medicines. ** Republican senators voted against the cap on the price of insulin in the private market, removing it from the package, and demonstrating a callous cave to pressures from Big Pharma at the expense of American citizens – 53% of whom support an insulin cap by Congress.
---
| | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://default.salsalabs.org/T497caa4a-fad6-408c-bf3d-460600eb0080/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
|
---
| | | Insulin costs about seven times as much in the U.S. as it does in peer countries, and costs have tripled over the past decade. And the costs can be detrimental – about 14% of diabetics in the U.S., nearly 1.2 million people spend at least 40% of their income (outside of food and housing costs) on insulin. Many people are forced to ration their doses, or simply cannot afford insulin at all, all because we refuse to rein in Big Pharma – and that can be deadly. American families are struggling. What Big Pharma is doing is not just unethical, it is life-threatening. We must have access to affordable medication. Congress must step in and cap insulin prices for all immediately, regardless of insurance status. [**If you agree, sign your name: "Cap insulin prices — save lives"**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tef385b07-9a43-4174-a4ce-2c68306a35b7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

clean_body: Cap insulin prices — save lives! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Peter, Congress passed the Inflation Reduction Act, which places a $35 cap on insulin for people 65 and over and on Medicare patients. But millions of diabetics on private insurance will still have to pay substantially more for insulin – in many cases, more than they can easily afford. And uninsured people have it the worst--they are much more likely to pay the full list price for insulin than the privately insured and are much more likely to be unable to afford prescription medicines. Republican senators voted against the cap on the price of insulin in the private market, removing it from the package, and demonstrating a callous cave to pressures from Big Pharma at the expense of American citizens – 53% of whom support an insulin cap by Congress. | | | | | | Insulin costs about seven times as much in the U.S. as it does in peer countries, and costs have tripled over the past decade. And the costs can be detrimental – about 14% of diabetics in the U.S., nearly 1.2 million people spend at least 40% of their income (outside of food and housing costs) on insulin. Many people are forced to ration their doses, or simply cannot afford insulin at all, all because we refuse to rein in Big Pharma – and that can be deadly. American families are struggling. What Big Pharma is doing is not just unethical, it is life-threatening. We must have access to affordable medication. Congress must step in and cap insulin prices for all immediately, regardless of insurance status. | | | | | | | | Thank you for being in this fight with us, Peter. clean_body: Today is our last chance to run our voter registration program in Georgia, Ohio, Florida, Texas, and Arizona before the deadlines. | | | | | | Friend, Since Roe was overturned, we’ve seen a massive wave of women registering to vote, particularly in states where abortion is under attack. But many of these hostile states also have particularly early voter registration deadlines, and if we want to reach voters in places like Texas and Ohio, we need to act NOW. We’re ready to reach 6.5 million eligible unregistered voters across 9 priority states, but to actually register voters, we need money in the door by today because this is our last chance to run our voter registration program in Ohio, Florida, North Carolina, Georgia, and Texas before their registration deadlines. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: We saw what happened in Kansas – proof that when we fight, we win. That’s why we are partnering with Vote Save America to register and mobilize prochoice voters in key areas to make a huge difference in November. You can make a difference in the midterms today. I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---

_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

| | Our organizing is paying off. Since launching our Gold Standards of Early Voting campaign, community partners and activists have come together to advocate for easier access in this fall’s elections, and here's what we’ve accomplished so far:
* In Chatham County, the Board of Registrars has adopted **two Sundays** of early voting
* In Fulton County, the election board has listened to the concerns of students and opened up **two days of early voting on college campuses**
* In Cobb County, the Board of Elections has approved its **first-ever Sunday** of early voting

**These wins are incredible! And we should all celebrate. ** But we still have more work to do. We still have more counties to visit as we continue our statewide tour urging county officials to adopt our full list of Gold Standards of Early Voting across Georgia. And this work is only possible because of supporters like you. [_**So we’re asking: can you chip in $20 or anything you can to support our work and this campaign to help increase public awareness and ensure early voting is more accessible across Georgia?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50663006/366715439/2032967978?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20220913_f_goldstandards_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmIwYjk5Yi1iMzMzLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vVg7AmYA2afZqCBPhszrOmC_jB6tR-KibWmkSM_fJcQ=) Past elections have shown us that offering Sunday voting increased turnout among Black voters by nearly 2%. And increasing the number of early vote locations will **increase turnout for all voters.** As we continue this tour with your continued support, we’ll keep demanding the full set of Gold Standards: early voting from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., two Sundays of early voting, and additional locations that are open for the entire duration of early voting — including high-capacity locations that are culturally relevant and accessible. **Fair Fight is committed to meeting Georgia voters where they are and ensuring the freedom to vote for every eligible voter. As we continue this tour with your continued support, we’ll keep demanding the full set of Gold Standards: early voting from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., two Sundays of early voting, and additional locations that are open for the entire duration of early voting — including high-capacity locations that are culturally relevant and accessible. Fair Fight is committed to meeting Georgia voters where they are and ensuring the freedom to vote for every eligible voter. That means building power and advocating for pro-voter policies like these Gold Standards.=** Thanks so much, The Fair Fight Team | = | 1270 Caroline Street Suite D120-311 Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2021 Fair Fight PAC - All rights reserved. subject: This rings true for almost all of us

body:
Almost every single Missourian I’ve met agrees that healthcare costs are just too plain high – and Washington isn’t doing nearly enough to fix the problem.
| | |
---
Peter, these past months, I’ve been traveling across my state, meeting MIssourians from all walks of life and hearing their stories.
I’ve learned so much from their conversations about the challenges that families are facing. And something that rings true for almost every single Missourian I’ve met is that healthcare costs are just too plain high – and Washington isn’t doing nearly enough to fix the problem.
I am pleased to see that the Inflation Reduction Act addressed some of these concerns. Make no mistake, this deal is a meaningful step forward – but it's not nearly enough.
**You see, we fell just _three votes_ short of passing insulin copay caps for all Americans.** As a nurse, I know just how difficult it is for families to afford this medication that they desperately need. More than 37 million Americans have diabetes – that's 1 person for every 10 of us.
**It's unfair and immoral to force families to choose between paying for groceries and affording lifesaving insulin.** The Senate must take action to right this wrong. That means electing more leaders who will fight for families, stand up to insurance companies, and make sure we all have access to the prescription medication we need.
**I promise you that when I get to the Senate, I will vote to cap insulin costs, and I will not rest until we secure the other two votes that we need to get this legislation across the finish line.**

name: Team Booker
subject: Lindsey Graham’s new abortion ban
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, it’s just
as we feared:

Yesterday, Charles wrote to you about Rand Paul and Senate Republicans'
plans to ban abortion nationwide. And just today, Lindsey Graham of South
Carolina led Senate Republicans as they introduced a bill that would ban
abortions after just 15 weeks of pregnancy.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220913.ivfOi8&refcode=em20220913-2477&t=1001&akid=2477%2E346206%2EwoHV55 ][IMG]

Peter, the
Republicans never fooled us. This was always part of their plan. Make no
mistake, Rand Paul will vote ‘yes’ on this cruel, backwards policy — and
he won’t stop until his extreme ‘Life at Conception Act’ is passed.

As Kentucky’s next Senator, Charles will never vote for Lindsey Graham’s
15-week nationwide abortion ban — or any legislation that will infringe on
fundamental reproductive rights or attack access to safe, quality health
care.

That’s why electing leaders like Charles Booker to represent Kentucky has
never been more urgent,
Peter — but we can’t get there
without spreading the word about Charles, and we certainly can’t get there
without your support.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220913.ivfOi8&refcode=em20220913-2477&t=1002&akid=2477%2E346206%2EwoHV55 ]Will you chip in $5 and help fund our plans for voter
outreach and organizing so we can send a true protector of safe and
quality health care to the Senate?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220913.ivfOi8&refcode=em20220913-2477&t=1003&akid=2477%2E346206%2EwoHV55 ]Contribute $5 →

- Team Booker

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Peter:

Ten years ago in 2012, Rand Paul first introduced his “Life at Conception
Act.” You may know what’s coming – this bill declares life at the moment
of fertilization.

His goal is to remove ALL exceptions from abortion laws and classify ANY
abortion as murder. It will even prohibit common birth control and outlaw
life-saving procedures that aren’t abortions.

It is the most extreme form of reproductive restriction on the table, so
extreme that 80% of Americans oppose it. To date, he has pushed for the
“Life at Conception Act” SIX different times. The last time was just last
year, during this current Senate session.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220913.ivfOi8&refcode=em20220913-2477&t=1004&akid=2477%2E346206%2EwoHV55 ]We cannot allow Rand the opportunity to wreak any more havoc on our
communities. I’m humbly asking: will you invest $5 to fuel
our campaign against this dangerous extremist?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220913.ivfOi8&refcode=em20220913-2477&t=1023&akid=2477%2E346206%2EwoHV55 ]Contribute $5 →

Peter, almost
one-fifth of Senators co-sponsored the bill. This is no fringe movement
Rand's spearheading – it’s an emboldened core of Republicans who will stop
at nothing to pass their sick agenda. Rand is leading an all-out attack on
women and families across America.

We cannot allow Rand the opportunity to wreak any more havoc on our
communities. Rand is campaigning so hard right now because he knows that
he is out of step with the people of Kentucky and our country.

We are gaining more momentum by the day while Rand Paul’s extreme ideas
remain deeply unpopular in Kentucky. Our people are ready for change – if
we go all in, we can and will win this race.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220913.ivfOi8&refcode=em20220913-2477&t=1024&akid=2477%2E346206%2EwoHV55 ]When we defeat Rand, we will immobilize his vicious movement AND gain
one more vote in the Senate for women’s rights. Can I ask you to make an
investment of $5 so we can compete with his corporate
funding?

In solidarity,

Charles Booker

We’ve known all along that they would never stop with overturning Roe.
#
**Lindsey Graham and Senate Republicans just introduced a national abortion ban bill.**
We’ve known all along that they would never stop with overturning Roe. The far-right’s plan from the start has been to ban abortion entirely, and my opponent has made clear that if he wins he would be a guaranteed vote for a nationwide abortion ban without exceptions.
They’ll take every chance they can to roll back our rights, and I’ve had enough. We will not back down as Washington politicians like Congressman Ted Budd work to take away our constitutional freedoms. Period.

Nan

This program is designed to help Republican candidates running in the top competitive districts around the country receive strategic support from Republican leadership.

Candidates in this exclusive program had to prove they could raise enough money to sustain their campaigns and pave a clear path to victory, in order to be given support by the NRCC.

Fellow American,

As you may know by now, when I ran and nearly knocked out a Democrat member of Congress in 2020,**[not $1 was spent by the national Republican Party.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=39762bcf6a3247659157bd25e352139d&_e=5a-v5t4U5T9MfNi1grcU1TC8QQjGuMnxU-XKLV2PDkH1zHwYPo213sAoXM57pbZRt3pMlZMr8IZwl3hlMVXVoJ8Uh2bD0sBK8XEp76QqDQzAqOYq6cXlVzqZadGjAIEYGOYRkGlpJu3q3-exvSbwjLRL49j5KxRpGNCqEfUDNUWklOe8kr0pUmJFrpacvkrDk3U6YByLd9jVpCzL_0DWGUYsvYAvK4lxN_NIpKwTllkhDOcf6X14aPJbiPHJPTAD7j-zqLPOIADWoa70cU__JhiXdCE7a9-HJhpTfXIx_9b1u1X-fZedCvYs7lwFvEKkxiwQq7MsZYHWoBobHA1KvfdYkamaEfdlsV1lXXy5UMmWBZsL0EgHzW_aW2QPIDnXvsf2PQSd1ql_jFP6_ZcUL7meMmZizb8tWRQmHccJiytCSg8N0cJ-BNL7amrkbqDu)** Back then, they didn’t know who I was, and they never dreamed they could win in an area of the country that, up until June, **had not sent a Republican to Congress in more than 100 years.**

**That was then. This is now.**

Democrats have shown time and again that they take the Hispanic vote for granted - and quite frankly, they don’t deserve our support because they don’t care what we think. **Democrats say that they are the party of inclusion and women’s rights, but they then proceed to attack the first Mexican American woman in Congress because she’s got an “R” next to her name rather than a “D.”**

Today, I’m running on the same platform that I did back in 2020: **Faith, love of family, and hard work.** It’s not that these are new interests of Hispanic majorities in South Texas, it’s that once upon a time, some Democrats stood for these values, and they defended them in Congress. That’s not the case anymore.

[** HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT ➞ **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=39762bcf6a3247659157bd25e352139d&_e=5a-v5t4U5T9MfNi1grcU1TC8QQjGuMnxU-XKLV2PDkH1zHwYPo213sAoXM57pbZRt3pMlZMr8IZwl3hlMVXVoJ8Uh2bD0sBK8XEp76QqDQzAqOYq6cXlVzqZadGjAIEYGOYRkGlpJu3q3-exvSbwjLRL49j5KxRpGNCqEfUDNUWklOe8kr0pUmJFrpacvkrDk3U6YByLd9jVpCzL_0DWGUYsvYAvK4lxN_NIpKwTllkhDOcf6X14aPJbiPHJPTAD7j-zqLPOIADWoa70cU__JhiXdCE7a9-HJhpTfXIx_9Z8nI269o664OaTW6xP-SpeSu4Dx-U5f8Bvk2XSbjhn4ZCv__bEFIT9CNkR-hlrR1jDEKjF2itu40nS-qEVo2lE4N1PdJrNJ44Wsklujnth2fG_fdIlm4vaG0iGfgHiD8y1IytVAa7mipf5NBxZcHrI)
Here in my district, people are upset that while they waited their turn to immigrate to the United States, **Democrats are actively ignoring laws on the book and allowing millions of migrants to come into our country illegally.** Why? Because the thinking goes that if they’re given enough handouts, these migrants will eventually be Democrat voters. I’m writing to you today, Fellow American, because I need your help. I don’t mince words and Democrats know that the polls currently favor me on November 8th. **Democrats know that I’m their biggest threat now, which is why they’ve reserved more than $2 million to attack me on TV and online through Election Day.**

| They believe that the government should control women’s bodies and personal reproductive freedom. They’re dead wrong. We need to make sure they pay the price at the polls this fall.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=878%2E5257348%2E4Koj8A)
Derek, Lindsey Graham and Senate Republicans are introducing an extreme 15-week national abortion ban in the Senate today.
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em_flippable_five.JQXZnL&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_RES_AC_20220913_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=878%2E5257348%2E4Koj8A)
In June, the Supreme Court upheld Mississippi’s 15-week abortion ban, which directly violated _Roe v. Wade_ , and ended the constitutional right to choose after nearly 50 years.
Now Republicans want to take this extreme abortion ban legislation nationwide.
Derek, a slim 50-50 Senate majority with the filibuster intact and a right-wing Supreme Court majority just isn’t cutting it. Republicans are continuing their efforts to roll back our rights at the state and federal level. They believe that the government should control women’s bodies and personal reproductive freedom. **_They’re dead wrong._** We need to make sure they pay the price at the polls this fall.
We need to **expand** our Senate majority so we can abolish the filibuster, expand the Court, and codify _Roe v. Wade_ nationwide.

Peter – Jeanne’s fighting every day on the campaign trail for the families of Minnesota’s 6th District and we’re preparing to get out the vote for workers’ rights and women’s rights in the pending election. **[Chip in to help give our communities a true voice in Congress>>](http://clicksp.hendricks2022.com/f/a/2aMY0OAWQhyQ9IP0Ul8gqw~~/AAPPAAA~_DrIGOACnUkUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAgw~~) ** As we’re talking with voters, we’re making sure everyone knows about Jeanne’s Republican opponent, Tom Emmer, and the shenanigans he’s up to in Washington, DC. So we thought we’d share some trivia about Emmer with you:
* As chair of the National Republican Congressional Committee, Tom Emmer is the person in DC whose job is to **spearhead and fund the reelections of extremist candidates like Marjorie Taylor Greene, Matt Gaetz, and Lauren Boebert.**

* Emmer has an atrocious record on women’s rights, opposing not just reproductive freedoms but also voting**against the Violence Against Women Act** and **against pay equity.**

* Last week, **Emmer called abortions “Chinese genocide,”** somehow being both sexist and racist in only two words.

* Emmer has become a **political lackey for far-right MAGA Republicans,** losing his connection with Minnesotans and prioritizing party loyalty over his own constituents.

Dear Friends,
Small, but mighty.
From our campaign kickoff in February to our all-out effort through this evening, this label was often used to describe our campaign. I am so proud of what we accomplished together these last seven months as we traveled across the Second Congressional District to hear from you and your families.
You welcomed me into your living rooms and kitchens, onto your front porches, and out to your backyards. You shared your stories, your concerns and hopes, and you asked all the important, tough questions about how we best move our state forward. Each day, thanks to your support, our campaign to send the state’s first Democratic woman to Congress got stronger and stronger.
And now we are taking that strength into November. We need to keep going to keep this seat firmly in Democratic hands. I know we can do this together.
So, today, I am asking you to join me in supporting our Democratic nominee, General Treasurer Seth Magaziner.
I love this state, and I know there is still so much good we can do together to make Rhode Island the best place to live, work, and raise a family.
With tremendous appreciation, and a mighty helping of gratitude,
Joy

name: Gavin Newsom
subject: Lindsey Graham
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY NEWSOM FOR CALIFORNIA – GOVERNOR – 2022
body:
We’re taking a different path in California.

Friends -
Earlier today, Lindsey Graham introduced legislation to ban abortion nationally.
He said if Republicans take power in November, it’ll get a vote.
We’re taking a different path in California.
Not only are we going to pass a constitutional amendment in California to protect a woman’s right to access an abortion, but today our state launched a new website to provide resources for women to get reproductive care — no matter where they live.
The site includes information on your right to abortion in California, and it includes information if you’re traveling to California from another state that has restricted access to an abortion.
The truth is, what Lindsey Graham and Republicans are doing is about controlling women, it’s not about “protecting life.”
It is honestly the height of perversity for national Republicans to call themselves “pro-life.”
These are people who largely oppose funding for prenatal care.
They are people who largely oppose paid family leave.
These are people who voted to take away health care under the Affordable Care Act.
And don’t even get me started on their response to the pandemic.
Give me a break.
People can access our new site at [**Abortion.Ca.Gov**](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/1175?t=1&akid=921%2E4767699%2E1_zSe4) if you’re looking for resources. Please share it with anyone you think needs it.
Thanks,
Gavin

**Gavin Newsom is up for re-election this November. Ballots drop soon and he needs your help. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Good News! We just received a major endorsement from the Vermont State Employees Association Union (VSEA)! **** The Vermont State Employees Union is a member-directed labor union representing public sector workers and fighting for and ensuring workers rights. They decided to endorse Brenda because she has been a steadfast supporter of labor and it is clear her administration will support Vermont State employees which is seriously lacking in the current administration **** The current administration has been obstructionist to the support of our Vermont State Employees instead of an ally. They have failed to adequately serve our teachers, our troopers, and the rest of our state employees. The current Governor vetoed the pension reform bill that helped State employees retain secured retirement benefits. Vermont State employees do vital work for our State and should be rewarded instead of neglected. As Governor, Brenda will do everything in her power to support state employees.

name: Jayapal HQ
subject: The harrowing incident at Pramila's home
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
The Washington Post talked with Pramila about the incident at her home in July.
#
Peter,
The Washington Post sat down with Pramila to discuss a harrowing incident at her home this past July. On a Saturday night, a man with a gun showed up outside Pramila’s home shouting aggressive, racist and sexist obscenities at the Congresswoman.
It was an especially scary incident after the events of January 6, 2021, when Pramila was trapped on the balcony of the House gallery as rioters stormed into the Capitol building.
[**We invite you to read The Washington Post’s accounting of events and their discussion with Pramila published late last week. It’s important to know the kind of hate and extremism that exists in all parts of our country so that we can fight against it by holding perpetrators of violence accountable.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17268?t=1&akid=1615%2E420207%2EH_4EgX)
**[Read the Article](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17268?t=2&akid=1615%2E420207%2EH_4EgX)**
Thank you for your time today, and for giving the article and Pramila’s words a read if you have a few minutes.
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

The counties comprising the Rio Gr | [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=c5105132435149468ab2b51dba7a64c8&_e=GtbOJGj7VUfBhyqocR_1N8I7KNL7W-kRtrKG4fDgman_B-AmIoxC08gGgEXN5DtNaMS5xyRSNLCivTARAWKSUbdOk8zkA505-4iNV3YpnYfJ-vfcvnuQECcRJC3dfwdvEpya2QQQo3E_ZdJgRf7gt7INLcDoWEqC848nPjwNGJvjX22ExAk-7TKDZtQ0GgFqubvWz1xCnmYqZUu6jMElLYm3fyXv-fE0IKDn9EKM3ryJ7_5nR9e4R5TTqaGaO1S7ONB2_jRcFBMJXZbMixZj3BZ_Y_IjUesaKOuS5f8dluc-UPmCJZ52PX7gAcRlOMoIqzxGv2-e62vXPFl-WTc_yFJRxafuYJk8tC_rGpb8BEhM9le-DntGWmUo3zSfHtpOLYg8-ecroZDILkorS-gzFGMLWwoFcZ5QAAvvu_gDDCUDwXdkJuHYNq_W-Rq9dg27)

Peter,

As you may know by now, when I ran and nearly knocked out a Democrat member of Congress in 2020,**[not $1 was spent by the national Republican Party.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=c5105132435149468ab2b51dba7a64c8&_e=GtbOJGj7VUfBhyqocR_1N8I7KNL7W-kRtrKG4fDgman_B-AmIoxC08gGgEXN5DtNaMS5xyRSNLCivTARAWKSUbdOk8zkA505-4iNV3YpnYfJ-vfcvnuQECcRJC3dfwdvEpya2QQQo3E_ZdJgRf7gt7INLcDoWEqC848nPjwNGJvjX22ExAk-7TKDZtQ0GgFqubvWz1xCnmYqZUu6jMElLYm3fyXv-fE0IKDn9EKM3ryJ7_5nR9e4R5TTqaGaO1S7ONB2_jRcFBMJXZbMixZj3BZ_Y_IjUesaKOuS5f8dludmeab5TpnaOg3F1rnS1bSX6e1tRi62yEbZ9YKyACBNGBLrjRX8WELlzsVtX-_P-BXPnjH5GttX9gdAZIIP4DVRIU-FZe4lEZEdmwACLGd_R4Bqaxzn9yrFgILojeHTInmRmkkWX62Q1IaBUJySXzML)** Back then, they didn’t know who I was, and they never dreamed they could win in an area of the country that, up until June, **had not sent a Republican to Congress in more than 100 years.**

**That was then. This is now.**

Democrats have shown time and again that they take the Hispanic vote for granted - and quite frankly, they don’t deserve our support because they don’t care what we think. **Democrats say that they are the party of inclusion and women’s rights, but they then proceed to attack the first Mexican American woman in Congress because she’s got an “R” next to her name rather than a “D.”**

Today, I’m running on the same platform that I did back in 2020: **Faith, love of family, and hard work.** It’s not that these are new interests of Hispanic majorities in South Texas, it’s that once upon a time, some Democrats stood for these values, and they defended them in Congress. That’s not the case anymore.

[** HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT ➞ **](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=c5105132435149468ab2b51dba7a64c8&_e=GtbOJGj7VUfBhyqocR_1N8I7KNL7W-kRtrKG4fDgman_B-AmIoxC08gGgEXN5DtNaMS5xyRSNLCivTARAWKSUbdOk8zkA505-4iNV3YpnYfJ-vfcvnuQECcRJC3dfwdvEpya2QQQo3E_ZdJgRf7gt7INLcDoWEqC848nPjwNGJvjX22ExAk-7TKDZtQ0GgFqubvWz1xCnmYqZUu6jMElLYm3fyXv-fE0IKDn9EKM3ryJ7_5nR9e4R5TTqaGaO1S7ONB2_jRcFBMJXZbMixZj3BZ_Y_IjUesaKOuS5f8dlufb4kgX_P3KBsddzY6Q0gxk1LNHK4xaN9OU1eWQCcdh_AJbm5-sT_SbIJoCnLZN9I6EFHzNtxa0eaDxZLRpCwJcSGYwiuiSxqY4RSTQWixuiesHasihtpvkPLVA5a1z3kNh8wXaC6Vr9dPVDq0NZcR5)
Here in my district, people are upset that while they waited their turn to immigrate to the United States, **Democrats are actively ignoring laws on the book and allowing millions of migrants to come into our country illegally.** Why? Because the thinking goes that if they’re given enough handouts, these migrants will eventually be Democrat voters. I’m writing to you today, Peter, because I need your help. I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.
